class.name: AudioOcclusionProbePlanner
class.brief_description: Deterministic, age-fair admission of bounded spatial-audio obstruction probes.
class.description: Selects which 3D voices are due for a geometry/terrain occlusion ray in the current physics frame. Pure data scheduler: the caller performs all raycasts and sound filtering. At most 128 inputs and 16 output indices. Increasing overdue age prevents starvation; this class never modifies audio, physics, scenes or server-side AI.

method.name: select_due
method.description: Returns due indices in decreasing urgency: time overdue + 0.15 seconds per priority tier 0..3. Ties prefer higher audibility, then smaller stable ID. Up to 128 equal-length entries with finite nonnegative due times, finite audibility and unique positive IDs. Clock must be finite, nonnegative and at most 1e9 seconds; budget 0..16. Future-due voices are not selected. Invalid input returns an empty array.
